lines: Then, having worshipped the god, his kuśa-form
established in front, by the guru-derived
teaching-order let him see it; rising
from muladhara, crossing by seminal power
the endless nerve-path-staff to the nose-sky,
scattering — let him seek to pervade.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tato devaṃ pūjayitvā tadākṛtiṃ kuśādimayīm agre sthāpayitvā gurvāsāditajñānopadeśakrameṇa tāṃ paśyet sa ca mūlādhārād udetya prasṛtasuvitatānantanāḍyadhvadaṇḍaṃ vīryeṇākramya nāsāgaganaparigataṃ vikṣipan vyāptum īṣṭe
